gaps.lead: The film was so long that we missed the last bus.
gaps.sentence: It was ___ that we missed the last bus.
gaps.explanation: so long (a film) → such a long film.

gaps.lead: This is the worst traffic I've ever experienced.
gaps.explanation: Never before + have + subject + participle: Never have I experienced.

gaps.lead: I don't usually drink coffee at night.
gaps.explanation: be (not) used to = (not) accustomed to: I'm not used to coffee at night.

gaps.lead: He didn't pass the exam because he hadn't studied.
gaps.sentence: If he ___ , he would have passed the exam.
gaps.explanation: Third conditional: if + past perfect, would have + participle.

gaps.sentence: They announced that ___ selling the house.
gaps.explanation: we → they; present continuous → past continuous: they were selling.

gaps.lead: He started playing golf at the age of six.
gaps.sentence: He ___ golf at the age of six.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby/sport): took up golf.
